title: HELIOS multi-LLM hub configuration (config/aihub.json, config/aihub.cloud.json)
description: Bound 1:1 to src/ai/HELIOS.AIHub/Configuration/AIHubOptions.cs: providers (map of provider entries), cliAgents (list), routing (defaultChain + taskRouting) and learning. Property names, types and enums match the binder; required lists match what the hub dereferences without a fallback (provider.type, an agent's name / command / argsTemplate, a chain's entries) plus the two sections a hub cannot serve a request without (providers, routing — the binder defaults them to empty, which leaves every route with an empty chain). The binder ignores unknown keys (System.Text.Json default) and scripts/bootstrap/auth-doctor.ps1 only type-checks the keys it knows, so objects are deliberately NOT closed here - an unknown key is tolerated exactly as the runtime tolerates it. No secrets: credential fields hold environment-variable NAMES (Key Vault secret names as fallback).

providers.description: Provider key (the name routing chains use) -> provider entry.

envName.description: The NAME of an environment variable; never its value.

chain.description: Ordered provider / CLI-agent names: first is primary, the rest are fallbacks.

type.description: Provider kind dispatched by ProviderFactory.CreateAll. The factory folds case before dispatch; this schema pins the canonical lower-case spelling so the shipped profiles, the docs and the bootstrap scripts (which compare the type untrimmed) stay greppable.

model.description: Default model, or the Azure OpenAI / Foundry DEPLOYMENT name.

apiKeyEnv.description: The NAME of the environment variable holding the key; an empty string selects Key-Vault-only resolution through apiKeySecretName (the shape scripts/bootstrap/auto-login.ps1 and auth-doctor.ps1 handle as a blank apiKeyEnv).

apiKeySecretName.description: Key Vault secret NAME used when the env var is unset.

baseUrl.description: Fixed base URL (github-models default, ollama default, anthropic-foundry override).

argsTemplate.description: Must carry the {prompt} slot; {model} is optional. The prompt is passed as one argv element, never through a shell.

taskRouting.description: Task type -> ordered chain. A key of the form <taskType>:<language> (e.g. code_generation:fsharp) is a language-qualified chain consulted before the bare task type; the language part is the normalized lower-case key TaskTypeRoutingStrategy.NormalizeLanguage produces (csharp, fsharp, cpp, python, powershell, bicep, yaml, json). One ':' at most - SplitRoutingKey splits at the first.

localPath.description: JSONL outcome log; a relative path anchors to the config root.

adaptiveRouting.description: true lets recorded history reorder chains; false records only.
